## Type of change

<!-- Tick one (or more, if genuinely mixed). -->

- [ ] Other (describe):

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit, harness, or manual checklist under `docs/manual-tests/`).
- [ ] Formatters pass locally: `npx prettier --check .`, `dotnet csharpier --check .`, `dotnet xstyler --recursive --directory app --passive`, `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`.
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour or public contracts changed (`docs/architecture/*`, `README.md`, module `README.md`).
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:`, `perf:`).
- [ ] No new compiler warnings; `TreatWarningsAsErrors` still holds in Release.
